description: p6's set with its first record naming a predecessor, the digest of a record the set does not carry. The first record's prev_digest must be null (genesis), so the record rejects with continuity_reject: a set that continues a chain it does not present is not that chain from its start, however its records are numbered. The links are p6's, computed from the genesis predecessor, so they still recompute; an engine that checks predecessors only from the second record on accepts this vector. p6 is the accepting twin.
